046/**
047 * Session object that lives for the duration of a single use of {@link Parser}.
048 *
049 * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
050 *    <li class='warn'>This class is not thread safe and is typically discarded after one use.
051 * </ul>
052 *
053 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
054 *    <li class='link'><a class="doclink" href="https://juneau.apache.org/docs/topics/SerializersAndParsers">Serializers and Parsers</a>
055
056 * </ul>
057 */
058@SuppressWarnings({
059   "java:S112", // throws Exception intentional - callback/lifecycle method
060   "java:S1192", // Duplicated literals (argument/property names) read more clearly inline than as constants
061   "java:S1452", // create(), getClassMeta() and getListenerClass() expose wildcard Builder<?>/ClassMeta<?>/Class<? extends ParserListener> because the concrete type is not known statically
062   "rawtypes", // Raw types necessary for generic type handling throughout parser session
063   "resource", // pipe field holds the per-parse ParserPipe whose lifecycle is managed by the session, not owned as a standalone field.
064   "unchecked" // Type erasure requires unchecked casts throughout parser session
065})
066public class ParserSession extends MarshallingSession {
067
068   /**
069    * Default value for {@link Builder#maxParseDepth(int)}.
070    */
071   protected static final int DEFAULT_MAX_PARSE_DEPTH = 1000;
072
073   /**
074    * Builder class.
075    */
076   @SuppressWarnings({
077      "java:S119" // 'SELF' (CRTP self-type) is intentional and clearer than a single-letter name.
078   })
079   public abstract static class Builder<SELF extends Builder<SELF>> extends MarshallingSession.Builder<SELF> {
080
081      private HttpPartSchema schema;
082      private Method javaMethod;
083      private Object outer;
084      private boolean trimStrings;
085      private Nulls nulls;
086      private int maxParseDepth = DEFAULT_MAX_PARSE_DEPTH;
087      private Parser ctx;
088
089      /**
090       * Constructor
091       *
092       * @param ctx The context creating this session.
093       *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
094       */
095      protected Builder(Parser ctx) {
096         super(reqnn("ctx", ctx).getMarshallingContext());
097         this.ctx = ctx;
098         mediaTypeDefault(ctx.getPrimaryMediaType());
099         trimStrings = ctx.isTrimStrings();
100         nulls = ctx.getNulls();
101      }
102
103      @Override
104      public ParserSession build() {
105         return new ParserSession(this);
106      }
107
108      /**
109       * The java method that called this serializer, usually the method in a REST servlet.
110       *
111       * @param value
112       *    The new property value.
113       *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> to leave (or clear) the associated java method unset.
114       * @return This object.
115       */
116      public SELF javaMethod(Method value) {
117         javaMethod = value;
118         return self();
119      }
120
121
122      /**
123       * The outer object for instantiating top-level non-static inner classes.
124       *
125       * @param value
126       *    The new property value.
127       *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (no outer object will be used, suitable for static or top-level classes).
128       * @return This object.
129       */
130      public SELF outer(Object value) {
131         outer = value;
132         return self();
133      }
134
135      /**
136       * The shared recursive-parse-depth budget honored by binary codec sessions (CBOR, Protobuf, MsgPack)
137       * at their recursive databind entry points.
138       *
139       * @param value
140       *    The new property value.
141       *    <br>Defaults to {@value ParserSession#DEFAULT_MAX_PARSE_DEPTH}.
142       * @return This object.
143       * @see ParserSession#enterParseDepth()
144       */
145      public SELF maxParseDepth(int value) {
146         maxParseDepth = value;
147         return self();
148      }
149
150      @Override /* Overridden from Builder */
151      public SELF property(String key, Object value) {
152         if (key == null) {
153            super.property(key, value);
154            return self();
155         }
156         switch (key) {
157            case "javaMethod", "ParserSession.javaMethod":
158               return javaMethod(cvt(value, Method.class));
159            case "outer", "ParserSession.outer":
160               return outer(value);
161            case "schema", "ParserSession.schema":
162               return schema(cvt(value, HttpPartSchema.class));
163            case "trimStrings", "ParserSession.trimStrings":
164               return trimStrings(cvt(value, Boolean.class));
165            case "nulls", "ParserSession.nulls":
166               return nulls(cvt(value, Nulls.class));
167            case "maxParseDepth", "ParserSession.maxParseDepth":
168               return maxParseDepth(cvt(value, Integer.class));
169            default:
170               super.property(key, value);
171               return self();
172         }
173      }
174
175      /**
176       * Trim parsed strings.
177       *
178       * @param value The new value for this setting.
179       * @return This object.
180       */
181      public SELF trimStrings(boolean value) {
182         trimStrings = value;
183         return self();
184      }
185
186      /**
187       * Per-session override for the parser's null-coercion policy.
188       *
189       * @param value The new value for this setting.  {@code null} is treated as {@link Nulls#NOT_SET}.
190       * @return This object.
191       * @see Parser.Builder#nulls(Nulls)
192       * @since 10.0.0
193       */
194      public SELF nulls(Nulls value) {
195         nulls = value == null ? Nulls.NOT_SET : value;
196         return self();
197      }
198
199      /**
200       * HTTP-part schema.
201       *
202       * <p>
203       * Used for schema-based serializers and parsers to define additional formatting.
204       *
205       * @param value
206       *    The new value for this property.
207       *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (will not set the value, keeps existing schema or remains <jk>null</jk>).
208       * @return This object.
209       */
210      public SELF schema(HttpPartSchema value) {
211         if (nn(value))
212            schema = value;
213         return self();
214      }
215
216      /**
217       * Same as {@link #schema(HttpPartSchema)} but doesn't overwrite the value if it is already set.
218       *
219       * @param value
220       *    The new value for this property.
221       *    <br>If <jk>null</jk>, the value will not be set (keeps existing schema or remains <jk>null</jk>).
222       * @return This object.
223       */
224      public SELF schemaDefault(HttpPartSchema value) {
225         if (nn(value) && schema == null)
226            schema = value;
227         return self();
228      }
229
230   }
231
232   /**
233    * Concrete default builder leaf for the non-subclassed {@code create()} path (CRTP terminal).
234    */
235   public static final class DefaultBuilder extends Builder<DefaultBuilder> {
236
237      DefaultBuilder(Parser ctx) {
238         super(ctx);
239      }
240   }
241
242   /**
243    * Creates a new builder for this object.
244    *
245    * @param ctx The context creating this session.
246    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
247    * @return A new builder.
248    */
249   public static Builder<?> create(Parser ctx) {
250      return new DefaultBuilder(reqnn("ctx", ctx));
251   }
252
253   /**
254    * Convenience method for calling the {@link NameProperty @NameProperty} method on the specified object if it exists.
255    *
256    * @param cm The class type of the object.
257    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (no-op).
258    * @param o The object.
259    * @param name The name to set.
260    * @throws ExecutableException Exception occurred on invoked constructor/method/field.
261    */
262   protected static final void setName(ClassMeta<?> cm, Object o, Object name) throws ExecutableException {
263      if (nn(cm)) {
264         Property m = cm.getNameProperty();
265         if (nn(m) && m.canWrite())
266            m.set(o, name);
267      }
268   }
269
270   /**
271    * Convenience method for calling the {@link ParentProperty @ParentProperty} method on the specified object if it
272    * exists.
273    *
274    * @param cm The class type of the object.
275    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (no-op).
276    * @param o The object.
277    * @param parent The parent to set.
278    * @throws ExecutableException Exception occurred on invoked constructor/method/field.
279    */
280   protected static final void setParent(ClassMeta<?> cm, Object o, Object parent) throws ExecutableException {
281      if (cm == null)
282         return;
283      Property m = cm.getParentProperty();
284      if (nn(m) && m.canWrite())
285         m.set(o, parent);
286   }
287
288   /**
289    * Returns the nearest enclosing bean used as the parent for {@link ParentProperty @ParentProperty} injection.
290    *
291    * <p>
292    * Unlike {@link #getOuter()} (which also serves as the instantiation context for non-static member/inner classes),
293    * this value tracks only the nearest enclosing <i>bean</i> as the object graph is parsed, deliberately skipping any
294    * intermediate collections/maps/arrays.  It is {@code null} at the document root (no enclosing bean), which means a
295    * bean parsed at the root or directly inside a top-level collection has no parent injected.
296    *
297    * @return The nearest enclosing bean, or {@code null} if there is none.
298    */
299   protected final Object parentBean() {
300      return parentBean;
301   }
302
303   /**
304    * Sets the nearest-enclosing-bean tracker used for {@link ParentProperty @ParentProperty} injection.
305    *
306    * <p>
307    * Callers should invoke this when they begin populating a bean's properties (passing that bean), then pass the
308    * returned previous value back to this method once done, restoring the tracker stack-style.
309    *
310    * @param value The new nearest enclosing bean (typically the bean currently being populated).
311    * @return The previous value, to be passed back to this method to restore the tracker.
312    */
313   protected final Object swapParentBean(Object value) {
314      var old = parentBean;
315      parentBean = value;
316      return old;
317   }
318
319   private final HttpPartSchema schema;
320   private final Method javaMethod;
321   private final Object outer;
322   private final boolean trimStrings;
323   private final Nulls nulls;
324   private final int maxParseDepth;
325   private final Parser ctx;
326   private final ParserListener listener;
327   private final Deque<StringBuilder> sbStack;
328   private BeanPropertyMeta currentProperty;
329   private ClassMeta<?> currentClass;
330   private Object parentBean;
331   private Position mark = new Position(-1);
332   private ParserPipe pipe;
333   private int parseDepth;
334
335   /**
336    * Constructor.
337    *
338    * @param builder The builder for this object.
339    *    <br>Cannot be <jk>null</jk>.
340    */
341   protected ParserSession(Builder<?> builder) {
342      super(builder);
343      ctx = builder.ctx;
344      javaMethod = builder.javaMethod;
345      outer = builder.outer;
346      parentBean = builder.outer;
347      schema = builder.schema;
348      trimStrings = builder.trimStrings;
349      nulls = builder.nulls == null ? Nulls.NOT_SET : builder.nulls;
350      maxParseDepth = builder.maxParseDepth;
351      listener = BeanInstantiator.createOrNull(ctx.getListener());
352      sbStack = new ArrayDeque<>();
353   }

355   /**
356    * Returns the input as a string.
357    *
358    * <p>
359    * This always returns a value for input of type {@link CharSequence}.
360    * <br>For other input types, use {@link org.apache.juneau.marshall.Context.Builder#debug()} setting to enable caching to a string
361    * before parsing so that this method returns the input.
362    *
363    * @return The input as a string, or <jk>null</jk> if no pipe has been created or we're reading from an uncached reader or input stream source.
364    */
365   public String getInputAsString() { return pipe == null ? null : pipe.getInputAsString(); }
366
367   /**
368    * Returns information used to determine at what location in the parse a failure occurred.
369    *
370    * @return A map, typically containing something like <c>{line:123,column:456,currentProperty:"foobar"}</c>
371    */
372   public final JsonMap getLastLocation() {
373      var m = new JsonMap();
374      if (nn(currentClass))
375         m.put("currentClass", currentClass.toString(true));
376      if (nn(currentProperty))
377         m.put("currentProperty", currentProperty);
378      return m;
379   }

389    * Returns the listener associated with this session.

399   /**
400    * Returns the current position into the reader or input stream.
401    *
402    * @return
403    *    The current position into the reader or input stream.
404    *    <br>Never <jk>null</jk>.
405    */
406   public Position getPosition() {
407      if (mark.line != -1 || mark.column != -1 || mark.position != -1)
408         return mark;
409      if (pipe == null)
410         return Position.UNKNOWN;
411      return pipe.getPosition();
412   }

428   /**
429    * Same as {@link #read(Object, Type, Type...)} except optimized for a non-parameterized class.
430    *
431    * <p>
432    * This is the preferred parse method for simple types since you don't need to cast the results.
433    *
434    * <h5 class='section'>Examples:</h5>
435    * <p class='bjava'>
436    *    ReaderParser <jv>parser</jv> = JsonParser.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>;
437    *
438    *    <jc>// Parse into a string.</jc>
439    *    String <jv>string</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, String.<jk>class</jk>);
440    *
441    *    <jc>// Parse into a bean.</jc>
442    *    MyBean <jv>bean</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
443    *
444    *    <jc>// Parse into a bean array.</jc>
445    *    MyBean[] <jv>beanArray</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, MyBean[].<jk>class</jk>);
446    *
447    *    <jc>// Parse into a linked-list of objects.</jc>
448    *    List <jv>list</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>);
449    *
450    *    <jc>// Parse into a map of object keys/values.</jc>
451    *    Map <jv>map</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, TreeMap.<jk>class</jk>);
452    * </p>
453    *
454    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
455    * @param input
456    *    The input.
457    *    See {@link #read(Object, Type, Type...)} for details.
458    * @param type The object type to create.
459    * @return The parsed object.
460    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
461    * @throws IOException Thrown by the underlying stream.
462    */
463   public final <T> T read(Object input, Class<T> type) throws ParseException, IOException {
464      try (var p = createPipe(input)) {
465         return readInner(p, getClassMeta(type));
466      }
467   }
468
469   /**
470    * Same as {@link #read(Object, Type, Type...)} except the type has already been converted into a {@link ClassMeta}
471    * object.
472    *
473    * <p>
474    * This is mostly an internal method used by the framework.
475    *
476    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
477    * @param input
478    *    The input.
479    *    See {@link #read(Object, Type, Type...)} for details.
480    * @param type The object type to create.
481    * @return The parsed object.
482    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
483    * @throws IOException Thrown by the underlying stream.
484    */
485   public final <T> T read(Object input, ClassMeta<T> type) throws ParseException, IOException {
486      try (var p = createPipe(input)) {
487         return readInner(p, type);
488      }
489   }

491   /**
492    * Parses input into the specified object type.
493    *
494    * <p>
495    * The type can be a simple type (e.g. beans, strings, numbers) or parameterized type (collections/maps).
496    *
497    * <h5 class='section'>Examples:</h5>
498    * <p class='bjava'>
499    *    ReaderParser <jv>parser</jv> = JsonParser.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>;
500    *
501    *    <jc>// Parse into a linked-list of strings.</jc>
502    *    List <jv>list1</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);
503    *
504    *    <jc>// Parse into a linked-list of beans.</jc>
505    *    List <jv>list2</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
506    *
507    *    <jc>// Parse into a linked-list of linked-lists of strings.</jc>
508    *    List <jv>list3</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);
509    *
510    *    <jc>// Parse into a map of string keys/values.</jc>
511    *    Map <jv>map1</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, TreeMap.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>);
512    *
513    *    <jc>// Parse into a map containing string keys and values of lists containing beans.</jc>
514    *    Map <jv>map2</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, TreeMap.<jk>class</jk>, String.<jk>class</jk>, List.<jk>class</jk>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
515    * </p>
516    *
517    * <p>
518    * <c>Collection</c> classes are assumed to be followed by zero or one objects indicating the element type.
519    *
520    * <p>
521    * <c>Map</c> classes are assumed to be followed by zero or two meta objects indicating the key and value types.
522    *
523    * <p>
524    * The array can be arbitrarily long to indicate arbitrarily complex data structures.
525    *
526    * <h5 class='section'>Notes:</h5><ul>
527    *    <li class='note'>
528    *       Use the {@link #read(Object, Class)} method instead if you don't need a parameterized map/collection.
529    * </ul>
530    *
531    * @param <T> The class type of the object to create.
532    * @param input
533    *    The input.
534    *    <br>Character-based parsers can handle the following input class types:
535    *    <ul>
536    *       <li><jk>null</jk>
537    *       <li>{@link Reader}
538    *       <li>{@link CharSequence}
539    *       <li>{@link InputStream} containing UTF-8 encoded text (or charset defined by
540    *          {@link ReaderParser.Builder#streamCharset(Charset)} property value).
541    *       <li><code><jk>byte</jk>[]</code> containing UTF-8 encoded text (or charset defined by
542    *          {@link ReaderParser.Builder#streamCharset(Charset)} property value).
543    *    </ul>
544    *    <br>Stream-based parsers can handle the following input class types:
545    *    <ul>
546    *       <li><jk>null</jk>
547    *       <li>{@link InputStream}
548    *       <li><code><jk>byte</jk>[]</code>
549    *    </ul>
550    * @param type
551    *    The object type to create.
552    *    <br>Can be any of the following: {@link ClassMeta}, {@link Class}, {@link ParameterizedType}, {@link GenericArrayType}
553    * @param args
554    *    The type arguments of the class if it's a collection or map.
555    *    <br>Can be any of the following: {@link ClassMeta}, {@link Class}, {@link ParameterizedType}, {@link GenericArrayType}
556    *    <br>Ignored if the main type is not a map or collection.
557    * @return The parsed object.
558    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
559    * @see MarshallingSession#getClassMeta(Type,Type...) for argument syntax for maps and collections.
560    * @throws IOException Thrown by the underlying stream.
561    */
562   public final <T> T read(Object input, Type type, Type...args) throws ParseException, IOException {
563      try (var p = createPipe(input)) {
564         return (T)readInner(p, getClassMeta(type, args));
565      }
566   }
567
568   /**
569    * Same as {@link #read(Object, Class)} but parses from a string and doesn't throw an {@link IOException}.
570    *
571    * <p>
572    * This is the preferred parse method for simple types since you don't need to cast the results.
573    *
574    * <h5 class='section'>Examples:</h5>
575    * <p class='bjava'>
576    *    ReaderParser <jv>parser</jv> = JsonParser.<jsf>DEFAULT</jsf>;
577    *
578    *    <jc>// Parse into a string.</jc>
579    *    String <jv>string</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, String.<jk>class</jk>);
580    *
581    *    <jc>// Parse into a bean.</jc>
582    *    MyBean <jv>bean</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, MyBean.<jk>class</jk>);
583    *
584    *    <jc>// Parse into a bean array.</jc>
585    *    MyBean[] <jv>beanArray</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, MyBean[].<jk>class</jk>);
586    *
587    *    <jc>// Parse into a linked-list of objects.</jc>
588    *    List <jv>list</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, LinkedList.<jk>class</jk>);
589    *
590    *    <jc>// Parse into a map of object keys/values.</jc>
591    *    Map <jv>map</jv> = <jv>parser</jv>.read(<jv>json</jv>, TreeMap.<jk>class</jk>);
592    * </p>
593    *
594    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
595    * @param input
596    *    The input.
597    *    See {@link #read(Object, Type, Type...)} for details.
598    * @param type The object type to create.
599    * @return The parsed object.
600    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
601    */
602   public final <T> T read(String input, Class<T> type) throws ParseException {
603      try (var p = createPipe(input)) {
604         return readInner(p, getClassMeta(type));
605      } catch (IOException e) {
606         throw new ParseException(e); // Shouldn't happen.
607      }
608   }
609
610   /**
611    * Same as {@link #read(Object, ClassMeta)} except parses from a string and doesn't throw an {@link IOException}.
612    *
613    * <p>
614    * This is mostly an internal method used by the framework.
615    *
616    * @param <T> The class type of the object being created.
617    * @param input
618    *    The input.
619    *    See {@link #read(Object, Type, Type...)} for details.
620    * @param type The object type to create.
621    * @return The parsed object.
622    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
623    */
624   public final <T> T read(String input, ClassMeta<T> type) throws ParseException {
625      try (var p = createPipe(input)) {
626         return readInner(p, type);
627      } catch (IOException e) {
628         throw new ParseException(e); // Shouldn't happen.
629      }
630   }

637    *    The input.
638    *    <br>Character-based parsers can handle the following input class types:
639    *    <ul>
640    *       <li><jk>null</jk>
641    *       <li>{@link Reader}
642    *       <li>{@link CharSequence}
643    *       <li>{@link InputStream} containing UTF-8 encoded text (or charset defined by
644    *          {@link ReaderParser.Builder#streamCharset(Charset)} property value).

646    *          {@link ReaderParser.Builder#streamCharset(Charset)} property value).

649    *    <ul>

653    *    </ul>

663    * @see MarshallingSession#getClassMeta(Type,Type...) for argument syntax for maps and collections.
664    */
665   public final <T> T read(String input, Type type, Type...args) throws ParseException {

780   /**
781    * Entry point for all parsing calls.
782    *
783    * <p>
784    * Calls the {@link #doRead(ParserPipe, ClassMeta)} implementation class and catches/re-wraps any exceptions
785    * thrown.
786    *
787    * @param pipe The parser input.
788    * @param type The class type of the object to create.
789    * @param <T> The class type of the object to create.
790    * @return The parsed object.
791    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
792    * @throws IOException Thrown by the underlying stream.
793    */
794   private <T> T readInner(ParserPipe pipe, ClassMeta<T> type) throws ParseException, IOException {
795      if (type.isVoid())
796         return null;
797      if (BeanSupplier.class.isAssignableFrom(type.inner()) && !BeanChannel.class.isAssignableFrom(type.inner()))
798         throw new ParseException(this, "BeanSupplier cannot be used as a parser target. Use BeanConsumer or BeanChannel for round-trip support.");
799      try {
800         var r = doRead(pipe, type);
801         // Primitive optionals (OptionalInt/Long/Double) are parsed as first-class optionals — the format
802         // parsers wrap the element in a generic Optional, so coerce the top-level result to the matching
803         // primitive-optional type (mirrors the Optional<T> contract; absent/null already resolved to empty).
804         if (type.isPrimitiveOptional() && ! type.inner().isInstance(r))
805            return convertToType(r, type);
806         return r;
807      } catch (ParseException | IOException e) {
808         throw e;
809      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") StackOverflowError e) {
810         throw new ParseException(this, "Depth too deep.  Stack overflow occurred.");
811      } catch (Exception e) {
812         throw new ParseException(this, e, "Exception occurred.  exception=%s, message=%s.", cns(e), localizedMessage(e));
813      } finally {
814         checkForWarnings();
815      }
816   }

818   /**
819    * Parses the input and streams each parsed element into the given {@link BeanConsumer}.
820    *
821    * <p>
822    * This is the primary API for large-dataset parsing where parsed beans should be consumed lazily
823    * (e.g. inserted directly into a database) rather than collected into an in-memory collection.
824    *
825    * <p>
826    * The parser drives the full consumer lifecycle:
827    * <ol>
828    *    <li>Calls {@link BeanConsumer#begin()} before parsing starts
829    *    <li>Calls {@link BeanConsumer#acceptThrows(Object)} for each parsed element
830    *    <li>If {@link BeanConsumer#acceptThrows(Object)} throws, calls {@link BeanConsumer#onError(Exception)};
831    *        if {@code onError()} absorbs the exception, parsing continues to the next element
832    *    <li>Always calls {@link BeanConsumer#complete()} at the end (like {@code finally})
833    * </ol>
834    *
835    * <p>
836    * The default implementation parses the input into a {@link List} first and then feeds each element
837    * to the consumer. Format-specific subclasses may override {@link #doReadToBeanConsumer} for true
838    * streaming behavior without loading all elements into memory.
839    *
840    * @param <T> The element type.
841    * @param input The input to parse.
842    * @param consumer The consumer to receive parsed elements.
843    * @param elementType The type of each element.
844    * @throws ParseException If a parse error occurs that causes {@code onError()} to rethrow.
845    * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs reading the input.
846    */
847   public final <T> void readToBeanConsumer(Object input, BeanConsumer<T> consumer, Class<T> elementType) throws ParseException, IOException {
848      try (var p = createPipe(input)) {
849         doReadToBeanConsumer(p, consumer, elementType);
850      }
851   }
852
853   /**
854    * Format-specific implementation for {@link #readToBeanConsumer}.
855    *
856    * <p>
857    * The default implementation parses the input as a {@link List} and feeds each element to the consumer.
858    * Override this method in format-specific parsers to support true streaming without collecting all
859    * elements into memory.
860    *
861    * @param <T> The element type.
862    * @param pipe The parser input pipe.
863    * @param consumer The consumer to receive parsed elements.
864    * @param elementType The type of each element.
865    * @throws ParseException If a parse error occurs.
866    * @throws IOException If an I/O error occurs.
867    */
868   protected <T> void doReadToBeanConsumer(ParserPipe pipe, BeanConsumer<T> consumer, Class<T> elementType) throws ParseException, IOException {
869      List<T> list = (List<T>) doRead(pipe, getClassMeta(List.class, elementType));
870      if (list == null)
871         return;
872      var bodyThrown = drainToConsumer(consumer, list);
873      var completeThrown = completeQuietly(consumer);
874      if (bodyThrown != null) {
875         if (completeThrown != null)
876            bodyThrown.addSuppressed(completeThrown);
877         if (bodyThrown instanceof ParseException bodyThrown2)
878            throw bodyThrown2;
879         if (bodyThrown instanceof IOException bodyThrown2)
880            throw bodyThrown2;
881         throw new ParseException(this, bodyThrown, "Exception occurred.  exception=%s, message=%s.", cns(bodyThrown), localizedMessage(bodyThrown));
882      }
883      if (completeThrown != null)
884         throw new ParseException(this, completeThrown, "Exception occurred in BeanConsumer.complete().  exception=%s, message=%s.", cns(completeThrown), localizedMessage(completeThrown));
885   }
886
887   private static <T> Exception drainToConsumer(BeanConsumer<T> consumer, List<T> list) {
888      try {
889         consumer.begin();
890         for (var element : list)
891            acceptOrError(consumer, element);
892      } catch (Exception e) {
893         return e;
894      }
895      return null;
896   }
897
898   private static <T> void acceptOrError(BeanConsumer<T> consumer, T element) throws Exception {
899      try {
900         consumer.acceptThrows(element);
901      } catch (Exception e) {
902         consumer.onError(e);
903      }
904   }
905
906   private static Exception completeQuietly(BeanConsumer<?> consumer) {
907      try {
908         consumer.complete();
909         return null;
910      } catch (Exception e) {
911         return e;
912      }
913   }

916    * Throws {@link MissingRequiredPropertyException} if the bean map is missing {@code @BeanProp(required=true)} properties.
917    *
918    * <p>
919    * Call once per bean, after all input properties have been put into the map and before {@link BeanMap#getBean()}
920    * constructs it.  Do not call it for intermediate bean maps that are filled in later.
921    *
922    * @param <T> The bean type.
923    * @param m The bean map.  Can be <jk>null</jk>.
924    * @return The same bean map.
925    */
926   protected final <T> BeanMap<T> checkRequired(BeanMap<T> m) {
927      return MissingRequiredPropertyException.check(this, m);

930   /**
931    * Converts the specified {@link MarshalledMap} into a bean identified by the <js>"_type"</js> property in the map.
932    *
933    * @param m The map to convert to a bean.
934    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
935    * @param pMeta The current bean property being parsed.
936    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the <c>@MarshalledProp(dictionary={})</c> registry lookup is skipped).
937    * @param eType The current expected type being parsed.
938    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the <c>@Marshalled(dictionary={})</c> registry lookup on the expected type is skipped).
939    * @return
940    *    The converted bean, or the same map if the <js>"_type"</js> entry wasn't found or didn't resolve to a bean.
941    */
942   protected final Object cast(MarshalledMap m, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta, ClassMeta<?> eType) {
943
944      var btpn = getBeanTypePropertyName(eType);
945
946      var o = m.get(btpn);
947      if (o == null)
948         return m;
949      var typeName = o.toString();
950
951      var cm = getClassMeta(typeName, pMeta, eType);
952
953      if (nn(cm)) {
954         var bm = m.getMarshallingSession().newBeanMap(cm.inner());
955
956         // Iterate through all the entries in the map and set the individual field values.
957         m.forEach((k, v) -> {
958            if (! k.equals(btpn)) {
959               // Attempt to recursively cast child maps.
960               if (v instanceof MarshalledMap v2)
961                  v = cast(v2, pMeta, eType);
962               bm.put(k, v);
963            }
964         });
965         return checkRequired(bm).getBean();
966      }
967
968      return m;
969   }

971   /**
972    * Converts the specified string to the specified type.
973    *
974    * @param outer
975    *    The outer object if we're converting to an inner object that needs to be created within the context
976    *    of an outer object.
977    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> if the target is not a non-static inner class requiring an enclosing instance.
978    * @param s The string to convert.
979    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (returns <jk>null</jk>).
980    * @param type The class type to convert the string to.
981    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (defaults to <c>Object</c>).
982    * @return The string converted as an object of the specified type, or <jk>null</jk> if the input string was <jk>null</jk>.
983    * @param <T> The class type to convert the string to.
984    * @throws ParseException Malformed input encountered.
985    * @throws ExecutableException Exception occurred on invoked constructor/method/field.
986    */
987   @SuppressWarnings({
988      "java:S3776" // Cognitive complexity acceptable for type-conversion dispatch across all supported target types
989   })
990   protected final <T> T convertAttrToType(Object outer, String s, ClassMeta<T> type) throws ParseException {
991      if (s == null)
992         return null;
993
994      if (type == null)
995         type = (ClassMeta<T>)object();
996      var swap = type.getSwap(this);
997      var sType = swap == null ? type : swap.getSwapClassMeta(this);
998
999      var o = (Object)s;
1000      if (sType.isChar())
1001         o = parseCharacter(s);
1002      else if (sType.isNumber())
1003         o = parseNumber(s, (Class<? extends Number>)sType.inner());
1004      else if (sType.isBoolean())
1005         o = Boolean.parseBoolean(s);
1006      else if (sType.isDate())
1007         o = readDate(s, sType);
1008      else if (sType.isCalendar())
1009         o = readCalendar(s, sType);
1010      else if (sType.isTemporal())
1011         o = readTemporal(s, sType);
1012      else if (sType.isDuration())
1013         o = readDuration(s);
1014      else if (sType.isPeriod())
1015         o = readPeriod(s);
1016      else if (! (sType.isCharSequence() || sType.isObject())) {
1017         if (sType.canCreateNewInstanceFromString(outer))
1018            o = sType.newInstanceFromString(outer, s);
1019         else
1020            throw new ParseException(this, "Invalid conversion from string to class '%s'", type);
1021      }
1022
1023      if (nn(swap))
1024         o = unswap(swap, o, type);
1025
1026      return (T)o;
1027   }

1120   /**
1121    * Give the specified dictionary name, resolve it to a class.
1122    *
1123    * @param typeName The dictionary name to resolve.
1124    * @param pMeta The bean property we're currently parsing.
1125    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the <c>@MarshalledProp(dictionary={})</c> registry lookup is skipped).
1126    * @param eType The expected type we're currently parsing.
1127    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk> (the <c>@Marshalled(dictionary={})</c> registry lookup on the expected type is skipped).
1128    * @return The resolved class, or <jk>null</jk> if the type name could not be resolved.
1129    */
1130   protected final ClassMeta<?> getClassMeta(String typeName, BeanPropertyMeta pMeta, ClassMeta<?> eType) {
1131      BeanRegistry br = null;
1132
1133      // Resolve via @MarshalledProp(dictionary={})
1134      if (nn(pMeta)) {
1135         br = (BeanRegistry) pMeta.getBeanRegistry();
1136         if (nn(br) && br.hasName(typeName))
1137            return br.getClassMeta(typeName);
1138      }
1139
1140      // Resolve via @Marshalled(dictionary={}) on the expected type where the
1141      // expected type is an interface with subclasses.
1142      if (nn(eType)) {
1143         br = eType.getBeanRegistry();
1144         if (nn(br) && br.hasName(typeName))
1145            return br.getClassMeta(typeName);
1146      }
1147
1148      // Last resort, resolve using the session registry.
1149      return getBeanRegistry().getClassMeta(typeName);
1150   }

1360   /**
1361    * Enters one level of recursive databind parsing, enforcing the shared {@link Builder#maxParseDepth(int)}
1362    * budget (default {@value #DEFAULT_MAX_PARSE_DEPTH}).
1363    *
1364    * <p>
1365    * Binary codec sessions (CBOR, Protobuf, MsgPack) call this at their recursive databind entry point before
1366    * descending into a nested array/map/message element, and must call {@link #exitParseDepth()} in a matching
1367    * <jk>finally</jk> block regardless of outcome.  Exceeding the budget throws a {@link ParseException} so an
1368    * adversarial deeply-nested document fails cleanly instead of exhausting the call stack with a
1369    * {@link StackOverflowError}.
1370    *
1371    * <p>
1372    * Intentionally not applied to the JSON/XML/text parsers, whose recursive-descent parsers already rely on
1373    * {@link StackOverflowError} conversion at the outer parse boundary.
1374    *
1375    * @throws ParseException If the configured maximum parse depth was exceeded.
1376    */
1377   protected final void enterParseDepth() throws ParseException {
1378      if (++parseDepth > maxParseDepth) {
1379         parseDepth--;
1380         throw new ParseException(this, "Maximum parse depth exceeded (%s).", maxParseDepth);
1381      }
1382   }
1383
1384   /**
1385    * Exits one level of recursive databind parsing previously entered via {@link #enterParseDepth()}.
1386    *
1387    * <p>
1388    * Must be called exactly once per successful {@link #enterParseDepth()} call, in a matching <jk>finally</jk>
1389    * block so the depth counter is restored even when the nested parse throws.
1390    */
1391   protected final void exitParseDepth() {
1392      parseDepth--;
1393   }
1394
1395   /**
1396    * Runs a local, parser-controlled allocation (e.g. pre-sizing an array/collection/buffer from a
1397    * wire-declared count) and converts an {@link OutOfMemoryError} thrown specifically from it into a bounded
1398    * {@link ParseException}.
1399    *
1400    * <p>
1401    * Only an {@link OutOfMemoryError} thrown from {@code alloc}'s own execution is converted here.  Any other
1402    * {@link OutOfMemoryError} &mdash; one raised elsewhere in the call stack, signaling a JVM that is
1403    * genuinely running out of heap &mdash; is <b>not</b> this method's concern and is never observed by it; a
1404    * dying JVM is not a client input-validation failure and must not be reported as one.  Format-specific
1405    * parser sessions should route untrusted-length-driven local allocations through this helper instead of
1406    * relying on a blanket catch at an outer parse boundary.
1407    *
1408    * @param <T> The allocated object's type.
1409    * @param what A short human-readable description of what's being allocated, used in the exception message
1410    *    if the allocation fails.
1411    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1412    * @param alloc The allocation to attempt.
1413    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1414    * @return The allocated object.
1415    * @throws ParseException If {@code alloc} itself threw an {@link OutOfMemoryError}.
1416    */
1417   protected final <T> T allocateLocal(String what, Supplier<T> alloc) throws ParseException {
1418      try {
1419         return alloc.get();
1420      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") OutOfMemoryError e) {
1421         throw new ParseException(this, "Out of memory occurred.  Input too large to parse.  Allocation: %s", what);
1422      }
1423   }

1437   /**

1441    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1442    * @param t The throwable that the bean setter threw.
1443    */
1444   protected final void onBeanSetterException(BeanPropertyMeta p, Throwable t) {
1445      if (nn(listener))
1446         listener.onBeanSetterException(this, t, p);
1447      var prefix = "";
1448      addWarning("%sCould not call setValue() on property '%s' of class '%s', exception = %s", prefix, p.getName(), p.getBeanMeta().getBeanInfo(), localizedMessage(t));
1449   }

1451   /**
1452    * Method that gets called when an unknown bean property name is encountered.
1453    *
1454    * @param propertyName The unknown bean property name.
1455    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1456    * @param beanMap The bean that doesn't have the expected property.
1457    *    <br>Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
1458    * @param value The parsed value.
1459    *    <br>Can be <jk>null</jk>, in which case whether the property is ignored is governed by
1460    *    {@link MarshallingContext.Builder#ignoreUnknownNullBeanProperties()} rather than
1461    *    {@link MarshallingContext.Builder#ignoreUnknownBeanProperties()}.
1462    * @throws ParseException
1463    *    Automatically thrown if {@link MarshallingContext.Builder#ignoreUnknownBeanProperties()} setting on this parser is
1464    *    <jk>false</jk>
1465    * @param <T> The class type of the bean map that doesn't have the expected property.
1466    */
1467   protected final <T> void onUnknownProperty(String propertyName, BeanMap<T> beanMap, Object value) throws ParseException {
1468      var bmcm = (ClassMeta<T>) beanMap.getBeanInfo();
1469      if (propertyName.equals(getBeanTypePropertyName(bmcm)))
1470         return;
1471      if (! isIgnoreUnknownBeanProperties() && (nn(value) || ! isIgnoreUnknownNullBeanProperties()))
1472         throw new ParseException(this, "Unknown property '%s' encountered while trying to parse into class '%s'", propertyName, bmcm);
1473      if (nn(listener))
1474         listener.onUnknownBeanProperty(this, propertyName, bmcm.inner(), beanMap.getBean());
1475   }
